prerequisites: All credit points, including the practical phase, must have been earned, with the exception of 6 credit points from the 5th and 6th regular semesters.
Participation in 6 events from the lecture series of the Industry Seminar (INDS), effort: 6 times 1.5 hours distributed over the study period.
Participation in 2 Industry Days (INTG), i.e., visiting the annually held industry contact fair of TH Bingen, effort approx. 4 hours each.

learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to independently process a specialized problem using scientific methods within a given timeframe.
Students create a work plan and complete the work packages.
Students master self-organization and independent processing, as well as methods of information retrieval and problem-solving.
Students can document their results and present them as part of the bachelor thesis.

syllabus_topics: Specific problems of a subject area of the degree program
A university lecturer acts as a supervisor. They support the students in personal discussions regarding the adherence to the above-mentioned learning and qualification objectives

assessment_methods.method: study achievements (SL) as defined in prerequisites

assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of study achievements and passing the module examination. The weighting for the final grade is based on credit points.
